name: EMA LWMA RSI
summary: This EA combines EMA and LWMA moving average crossover signals with RSI filtering to identify trend-following entry opportunities. It opens buy positions when the faster moving average crosses above the slower one and RSI confirms momentum, and sells on the reverse condition. The strategy uses a dual-indicator confirmation approach to reduce false signals in ranging markets.
summary_zh: 该EA结合EMA和LWMA均线交叉信号与RSI过滤来识别趋势跟踪入场机会。当快速均线上穿慢速均线且RSI确认动量时开多仓，反向条件时开空仓。策略采用双指标确认方法来减少震荡市场中的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重均线交叉与RSI动量确认的组合：使用EMA作为快速均线、LWMA作为慢速均线（或反之），通过两者的交叉判断趋势方向。入场条件为快速均线上穿慢速均线且RSI高于设定阈值时做多，快速均线下穿慢速均线且RSI低于设定阈值时做空。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损或反向交叉信号平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险百分比控制，没有明确的单笔最大亏损限制。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但缺乏对市场震荡期的过滤机制，可能在横盘行情中频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual moving average crossover combined with RSI momentum confirmation: using EMA as the fast moving average and LWMA as the slow moving average (or vice versa), trend direction is determined by their crossover. Entry conditions are a buy when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and RSI is above a configured threshold, and a sell on the reverse crossover with RSI below its threshold. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or closing on a reverse crossover signal. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance or market volatility. Money management lacks risk percentage controls and has no explicit maximum loss limit per trade. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but lacks a ranging market filter, which may cause frequent false signals and consecutive losses during sideways conditions.
pros: 双指标确认机制减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优
趋势行情中能较好地捕捉中长期趋势波段
使用EMA和LWMA两种不同权重均线，提供更丰富的趋势信息
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize
Captures medium-to-long-term trend waves effectively in trending markets
Using both EMA and LWMA provides richer trend information with different weighting methods
cons: 缺乏横盘震荡市场的过滤机制，容易在非趋势行情中频繁亏损
固定手数仓位管理未考虑账户风险比例，大资金时风险不可控
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺乏点差过滤，在点差较大时仍可能进场导致额外成本
cons_en: No ranging market filter, prone to frequent losses in sideways/non-trending conditions
Fixed lot position sizing ignores account risk ratio, making risk uncontrolled with larger capital
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
No spread filter, may enter trades with high spread leading to extra costs
improvements: 添加ADX或波动率过滤器，在横盘行情中暂停交易以减少虚假信号
实现基于账户余额百分比的风险仓位计算，替代固定手数
添加新K线检查和点差过滤机制，提升执行健壮性
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to pause trading during ranging markets and reduce false signals
Implement risk-based position sizing using account equity percentage instead of fixed lots
Add new bar check and spread filter mechanisms to improve execution robustness

risk_points: 固定手数无风险比例控制，大资金环境下单笔亏损可能过大
缺乏横盘过滤，震荡行情中可能连续止损
未做新K线检查可能导致重复开仓
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing without risk percentage control can cause oversized single-trade losses with larger accounts
No ranging market filter may cause consecutive stop-losses during sideways markets
No new bar check may lead to duplicate position openings on the same candle

summary_en: This EA combines EMA and LWMA moving average crossover signals with RSI filtering to identify trend-following entry opportunities. It opens buy positions when the faster moving average crosses above the slower one and RSI confirms momentum, and sells on the reverse condition. The strategy uses a dual-indicator confirmation approach to reduce false signals in ranging markets.
